# Line-By-Line Makers Anvil Code Guide

This generated teaching artifact explains every physical line in each implementation, automation, metadata, and structured-contract file. Read it beside the real source: in-code docstrings/comments explain components and blocks, while this guide makes blank lines, delimiters, declarations, and formats that cannot contain comments explicit.

Regenerate with `python scripts/build_learning_guide.py`. Verify without writing with `python scripts/build_learning_guide.py --check`.

## `backend/src/makers_anvil_backend/server.py`

**Purpose:** Serves static assets, read APIs, and bounded guarded POST routes on loopback, including no-console desktop mode.

**Maintenance rule:** Preserve loopback binding, security headers, no CORS, bounded JSON, exact intake length, console-optional logging, and blocked mutation handling.

**Purpose:** Authorizes one selected local file and streams its exact bytes into private app-owned quarantine storage.

**Maintenance rule:** Preserve same-origin token checks, one-time expiry, allowlists, exact lengths, hashing, atomic replacement, rollback, and path privacy.

## `backend/src/makers_anvil_backend/services/execution_gate.py`

**Purpose:** Evaluates ten required evidence classes for one allowlisted route while execution remains impossible.

**Maintenance rule:** Never create requests, accept authorization, resolve paths, construct commands, run processes, write logs, cancel, or capture proof.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `e0f461abba57873bef3c8c10fd4c97d4bdfe08b07d7d9bdb749c5f04cabdb1c0` changes intentionally.

## `backend/src/makers_anvil_backend/services/execution_request.py`

**Purpose:** Composes deterministic logical execution intent, unaccepted authorization, and empty audit plans without persistence.

**Maintenance rule:** Keep scope aligned with execution gates and never persist requests, accept consent, write events, resolve paths, or run processes.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `f4263e448df16054e3dd62e07d7400c9b6a6addc2336b7839a84a20fd4ee6abe` changes intentionally.

## `backend/src/makers_anvil_backend/services/local_request_guard.py`

**Purpose:** Enforces one process token and exact loopback same-origin evidence for every bounded local mutation.

**Maintenance rule:** Keep the token memory-only and reject cross-site, remote, mismatched-host, credential-bearing, and non-HTTP origins.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `95e3112a63988513f06e7e521fd7225b49ef31fe309490dd3cc50fde60964076` changes intentionally.

## `backend/src/makers_anvil_backend/services/output_proof.py`

**Purpose:** Maps route previews to logical output bundles, planned artifacts, incomplete proof, and readiness blockers.

## `backend/src/makers_anvil_backend/services/tool_detection.py`

**Purpose:** Detects known tools through PATH and narrow standard locations while redacting resolved installation paths.

**Maintenance rule:** Never execute tools or version commands, read registry data, write files, or enable software actions.

## `backend/src/makers_anvil_backend/services/workspace_config.py`

## `frontend/public/assets/capability-lanes.js`

**Purpose:** Renders stable capability comparison rows from the path-redacted matrix contract.

**Maintenance rule:** Use safe DOM nodes, responsive columns, and never turn lane status into a command.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `dda1c365ee661b021a960f7c98d641fa33c659090cbca65f6c0a42bc271ac475` changes intentionally.

## `frontend/public/assets/context-help.js`

**Purpose:** Provides one keyboard-accessible dynamically positioned contextual-help dialog.

**Maintenance rule:** Use textContent, restore focus on Escape, remain viewport-contained, and expose no maker action.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `7df65db475347ff2b1e61cc6fefdc048a278b529955fd815d14832acc758624a` changes intentionally.

## `frontend/public/index.html`

**Purpose:** Defines the accessible workbench plus one-file choose, review, authorize, cancel, and feedback controls.

**Maintenance rule:** Keep one reviewed file per authorization and do not add drag/drop, paste, folders, archives, or operational route/tool/output controls.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `7e10569fb5c8323f4dac422b844fecbb36b77ec0dd0147bec4f5106aa629fc46` changes intentionally.

## `package.json`

**Purpose:** Declares Node-facing project metadata, repository identity, engines, and convenience verification commands.

**Maintenance rule:** Keep scripts thin wrappers around canonical Python entrypoints and avoid unnecessary frontend build dependencies.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `73669b95cf13bb18f080c377d9243624db059c3bc2e87b583f417307c4f4963d` changes intentionally.

## `schemas/intake-authorization.schema.json`

**Purpose:** Defines one short-lived one-time authorization for an exact selected-file name, kind, suffix, size, and timestamp.

**Maintenance rule:** Never add a source path or process token; keep consent bounded to one exact transfer.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `75a6e28ea1d359117a2acf2cb86605c9a746393f9df745efd7fd8ba7018397fb` changes intentionally.

**Purpose:** Defines authorized one-file copy limits, kind allowlists, capabilities, and disabled downstream safety controls.

**Maintenance rule:** Keep archives, folders, drag/drop, paste, handoff, route execution, tool launch, and unverified content blocked.

## `schemas/output-proof.schema.json`

**Purpose:** Defines output preview summaries, bundle plans, nonexistent artifacts, incomplete proof, readiness, and actions.

**Maintenance rule:** Require planned or not-proven states and keep create/open API actions constant false.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `d6727ad12ec636980a193132a2e0f26d12473ca0de722c4907b823073075b7af` changes intentionally.

## `schemas/tool-detection.schema.json`

**Purpose:** Defines platform and family summaries, path-redacted tool evidence, unproven versions, and blocked actions.

**Maintenance rule:** Keep resolved paths absent, version commands false, and every tool/software action disabled.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `59468e8268596d78f6486556d4092c9335c65517ecc658444aeec4aa9eb94d14` changes intentionally.

## `scripts/build_previous_app_learning_guide.py`

**Purpose:** Generates local exact line coverage for narrowly selected first-party previous-app source while excluding dependencies and outputs.

**Maintenance rule:** Never edit legacy source or traverse .venv, node_modules, dist, logs, ingress, Projects, caches, or generated outputs.

## `scripts/build_windows_exe.py`

**Purpose:** Inspects or runs the deterministic Windows PyInstaller one-file build with bundled frontend resources.

**Maintenance rule:** Keep dependencies pinned and never install, sign, publish, or claim installer or clean-machine proof through this builder.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `45b3f0f426142830bfcfa0b63d030c04cb0c1d335c6f6c38de849f9682c3dc75` changes intentionally.

## `state/current_status.json`

**Purpose:** Stores authoritative machine-readable current pass, percentages, proof, blocked work, and next pass.

**Maintenance rule:** Update in every completed pass and never claim untested platform, packaging, or action behavior.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `6b88e3899424f6874f51ef81e7d76a53a426b894e171e103718260d91195df17` changes intentionally.

## `state/pass_ledger.json`

**Purpose:** Stores the ordered bounded-pass history with report links and concise proof summaries.

**Maintenance rule:** Append one entry per completed pass; do not rewrite history to hide earlier boundaries.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `37ad2724ab3e70df43e2bb7a8990e00b5614ce3d26b12623c09f2118becad41a` changes intentionally.

**Purpose:** Exercises health, intake, preferences, activity, capability, planning, jobs, and blocked API contracts.

**Maintenance rule:** Allow only guarded intake and preference POST routes and add readable examples whenever contracts change.

## `tests/test_desktop.py`

**Purpose:** Proves secure native-window options, ephemeral server ownership, cleanup, smoke mode, and CLI dispatch without a GUI.

**Maintenance rule:** Inject fake pywebview behavior and never open a real window, external browser, tool, file dialog, or process in tests.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `3b8f74eff43b42292e8e17bc3e23bb081138d92b99c3ff14839b68b37adabfc7` changes intentionally.

## `tests/test_execution_request.py`

**Purpose:** Proves logical request previews, explicit unaccepted consent, empty audit records, fail-closed joins, and false effects.

**Maintenance rule:** Add negative cases whenever request scope, audit lifecycle, intent fields, or safety boundaries change.

## `tests/test_learning_guide.py`

**Purpose:** Proves generated guide bytes, selected file coverage, hashes, line totals, and representative explanation quality.

**Maintenance rule:** Keep deterministic and require regeneration whenever implementation or structured-contract source changes.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `922a4887fd468dc7a662e0bd1293dff65d44abcf103a13e285ae8ab65bc0ada1` changes intentionally.

## `tests/test_project_purity.py`

**Purpose:** Proves reference isolation, bounded mutations, safe planning/job policy, durable truth, and path purity.

**Maintenance rule:** Fail on undeclared POST routes, personal paths, broadened actions, stale truth, or runtime reference coupling.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `fa45a9112e52f73415dad8090cc3d2c64cf3497a7e5a7503ea5b17a3fb6907b1` changes intentionally.

## `tests/test_route_preview.py`

**Purpose:** Proves metadata-only routing, source independence, archive non-extraction, unmatched handling, and policy rejection.

**Maintenance rule:** Exercise each new route kind and assert preview state never becomes execution or source access.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `b2d17c217a0aa206c1a75676c01adb19e8e205f4dcbebe69870107c5b92394a6` changes intentionally.

## `tests/test_server.py`

**Purpose:** Proves loopback serving, security headers, complete authorized intake transfer, blocked mutation, and deterministic shutdown.

**Maintenance rule:** Use temporary roots and ephemeral ports; reject remote binds, CORS preflight, wrong media, and incomplete transfers.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `803bf2574a2824cce7975e345b4a0419dda91309800096fdceb31c5a4e462d05` changes intentionally.

## `tests/test_tool_dry_run.py`

**Purpose:** Proves deterministic tool selection, logical references, unsupported-family honesty, policy safety, and non-execution.

**Maintenance rule:** Use isolated route/output/tool snapshots and assert no command, resolved path, handoff, process, launch, or write escapes.

**Change example:** Modify this file only with its matching tests/contracts, then regenerate this guide so the recorded SHA-256 `0add44603a62ff8d765d90ffbcb866b2e9ca1ec4112862ba1f8e60fc5ca72f67` changes intentionally.

## `tests/test_verify_project.py`
